q: Do customer and visitor trips to our factory count in our carbon footprint?
title: Visitor travel in your footprint
short: Generally no. A customer's travel to your site is in their inventory, as their business travel. The electricity and fuel used while they are on site are already in your Scope 1 and 2. If you pay for a visitor's travel or hotel, count it in Scope 3 Category 6.
audience: Factories hosting audits and buyer visits

ul: You book and pay for the visitor's flights, trains or hotel.
You send a company car to collect them: already in your Scope 1 fuel.
The visitor's own company pays and arranges travel.

senseible: Senseible reads supplier invoices into dated records with the quantity, unit and factor on each line, and marks lines without a usable quantity as needing data instead of guessing.
